reason: The label is honestly what I look for: water, mate, fruit concentrate, nothing else. But I'm not ordering cans from a brand's own e-shop, and unless one of the 'selected cafés' happens to be one I already go to, I just won't come across it in a normal week.
objection: Where can I actually buy it? If it isn't on Rohlík or in the health store I shop at, it doesn't exist for me, and 55 CZK for one can in a café is a lot to try something.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in Rohlík's bio section or on the shelf at my health store, so I can add a few cans to my normal weekly order.
